SEARCH
Package neupaths.api

Class CellFactory

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.CellFactory
public class CellFactory extends Object
Creates cells according to cell definition files.

A cell definition file contains an XML schema for one of the NeuPaths cell types: BridgeCell, EventCell, ExtractorCell, InjectorCell, LoadBalancedCell, LoadControllerCell, LogicCell, RouterCell or Custom cell. The createCell(java.lang.String) method instantiates a NeuPaths cell according to the definition, returning a reference to the specific NeuPaths cell type. For example, a cell definition file that specifies a Logic cell would be used as follows:

    LogicCell myCell = CellFactory.createCell(myCellDefinition);

If the cell type is unknown at runtime, a less specific instantiation would be:

    Cell myCell = CellFactory.createCell(myCellDefinition);

Bridge Cells

A BridgeCell is specified as follows: 

     <bridge_cell>
     <name></name>
     <synapses>
         <synapse></synapse>
         ...
     </synapses>
     <subscriptions>
         <subscription>
             <cell_name></cell_name>
             <transmitter_name></transmitter_name>
             <domain></domain>
         </subscription>
         ...
     </subscriptions>
     <logging_enabled>true|false</logging_enabled>
     <trace_logging_enabled>true|false</trace_logging_enabled>
     <debug_logging_enabled>true|false</debug_logging_enabled>
     <runtime_logging_enabled>true|false</runtime_logging_enabled>
     <propagate_global_subscriptions>true|false</propagate_global_subscriptions>
     <subscription_refresh_interval_ms>n</subscription_refresh_interval_ms>
     <duplicate_detection_interval_ms>n</duplicate_detection_interval_ms>
     <subscription_trace_interval_ms>n</subscription_trace_interval_ms>
     <crypto_key_file>pathname</crypto_key_file>
 </bridge_cell>

Note: Only Bridge subscriptions are accepted (see BridgeSubscriptionSpec). In this case, the <subscription> element is an alias for <bridge_subscription>.

Load-Balanced Cells

A LoadBalancedCell is specified as follows: 

     <load_balanced_cell>
     <name></name>
     <properties>

             <name></name>

         </property>
         ...

     <synapses>
         <synapse></synapse>
         ...

             <name></name>
             <receptors>
                 <receptor>
                     <name></name>
                     <mode>buffered|non_buffered</mode>
                     <stimulus_class></stimulus_class>
                 </receptor>
                 ...
             </receptors>
             <transmitters>
                 <transmitter>
                     <name></name>
                     <stimulus_class></stimulus_class>
                     <trace>enabled|disabled</trace>
                 </transmitter>
                 ...
             </transmitters>
             <subscriptions>
                 <subscription>
                     <cell_name></cell_name>
                     <transmitter_name></transmitter_name>
                     <receptor_name></receptor_name>
                     <domain></domain>
                     <filter_transactions>enabled|disabled</filter_transactions>
                 </subscription>
                 <logic_subscription>
                     <cell_name></cell_name>
                     <transmitter_name></transmitter_name>
                     <receptor_name></receptor_name>
                     <domain></domain>
                     <filter_transactions>enabled|disabled</filter_transactions>
                 </logic_subscription>
                 <loopback_subscription>
                     <transmitter_name></transmitter_name>
                     <receptor_name></receptor_name>
                     <filter_transactions>enabled|disabled</filter_transactions>
                 </loopback_subscription>
                 <map_subscription>
                     <cell_name></cell_name>
                     <transmitter_name></transmitter_name>
                     <domain></domain>
                     <filter_transactions>enabled|disabled</filter_transactions>
                 </map_subscription>
                 ...
             </subscriptions>
             <transaction_history_window_ms>n</transaction_history_window_ms>
         </activator>
         ...
     </activators>
     <controller_name></controller_name>
     <controller_domain></controller_domain>
     <logging_enabled>true|false</logging_enabled>
     <trace_logging_enabled>true|false</trace_logging_enabled>
     <debug_logging_enabled>true|false</debug_logging_enabled>
     <runtime_logging_enabled>true|false</runtime_logging_enabled>
     <propagate_global_subscriptions>true|false</propagate_global_subscriptions>
     <subscription_refresh_interval_ms>n</subscription_refresh_interval_ms>
     <duplicate_detection_interval_ms>n</duplicate_detection_interval_ms>
     <subscription_trace_interval_ms>n</subscription_trace_interval_ms>
     <pulse_interval_ms>n</pulse_interval_ms>
     <crypto_key_file>pathname</crypto_key_file>
 </load_balanced_cell>

Notes:

  1. A LoadBalancedActivator must be provided. Additional activators may be used.
  2. Cell properties are optional.
  3. Activator transmitters are optional.
  4. Subscription filter_transactions are optional. They default to disabled.
  5. Only Logic-based subscriptions are accepted (see LogicSubscriptionSpec). In this case, the <subscription> element is an alias for <logic_subscription>. Loopback (<loopback_subscription>) and Map (<map_subscription>) subscriptions are also accepted.

     <runtime_logging_enabled>true|false</runtime_logging_enabled>

 </custom_cell>

Notes:

  1. Cell properties are optional.
  2. Activator transmitters are optional.
  3. Subscription filter_transactions are optional. They default to disabled.
  4. Only Logic-based subscriptions are accepted (see LogicSubscriptionSpec). In this case, the <subscription> element is an alias for <logic_subscription>. Loopback (<loopback_subscription>) and Map (<map_subscription>) subscriptions are also accepted.
  5. The custom cell class and constructor must be public.
  6. The custom cell class must have a constructor like the following: 

     public class MyCustomCell extends LogicCell
 {
   public MyCustomCell (String      name,
                        PropertySet properties,
                        String[]    synapseNames,
                        Activator[] activators,
                        byte[]      cryptoKey)
   {
     super(name, properties, synapseName, activators, cryptoKey);
     ...
   }
 }
